title: The 6 Best Massage Guns for Travel
h1: The 6 Best Massage Guns for Travel
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for massage guns for travel, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at massage guns for travel using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hyperice Hypervolt Go 2
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.5 lb compact body, 40W brushless motor, 3 speeds.
strengths: 1.5 lbs and a genuinely compact footprint make this the easiest full-brand gun to pack
USB-C charging shares a cable with most phones and laptops
QuietGlide motor is quiet enough for hotel rooms or shared travel spaces
limitations: Only 3 speeds compared with 5 on full-size competitors
Lower stall force than larger guns, fine for maintenance, less so for deep tissue work

products.name: TOLOCO Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 10 massage heads, Silent brushless motor, Multiple speed levels.
strengths: Low price makes it less stressful to travel with than a premium gun
Ten heads included covers most needs without extra purchases
Widely available, easy to replace if lost or damaged on a trip
limitations: Larger and heavier than dedicated compact travel guns like the Hypervolt Go 2
Auto shut-off at 10 minutes can interrupt longer recovery sessions

products.name: RENPHO Active Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 speed settings, 5 interchangeable heads, Carry case included.
strengths: Included carry case is built for exactly this use, keeping heads organized in one bag
USB-C charging is travel-friendly and shares a cable with most other devices
Strong enough for regular home use so you don't need a second gun just for trips
limitations: Not as compact or light as the Hypervolt Go 2
Five heads add bulk to the carry case versus a minimal travel setup

products.name: Bob and Brad Q2 Mini Massage Gun
limitations: Less stall force than full-size guns

products.name: Ekrin Athletics Bantam Mini Massage Gun

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
